prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production pixel-art battle background for RiftMon, a 2D monster RPG. Landscape 1536x1024. Polished hand-crafted 16-bit pixel art, clearly visible square pixel clusters, restrained detail and clean silhouettes matching a classic top-down monster RPG. Ground-level battle camera, broad empty fighting clearing in bottom half, depth toward upper half. No characters, creatures, text, UI, logos, circles, platforms or floor discs: Pokémon and their single enemy platform are drawn separately by the game. Dark green jungle, giant trees and hanging vines at edges, ominous purple-violet volumetric mist curling through the distant trees and ground edges, dusky plum lighting, ground still readable. Keep central foreground clear and bottom-left foreground unobstructed for our large back-facing Pokémon. No sun beams, blue sky or photorealism. Primary request: a new background for the true Dark Continent. Ancient overgrown stone ruins framing the clearing, mossy broken columns at far left/right, cracked earth and sparse grass, heavy layered violet mist, mysterious threatening atmosphere. The scene must read as a vast dark jungle beyond the familiar island. Balanced game composition: the enemy occupies the right half above the midpoint, our Pokémon the lower-left.
